criteria.clarifications: Exclude children and narrative reviews; each adult is an independent unit.
criteria.text: The study compares independent groups of adults.

criteria.clarifications: Step cards that give a structured list of task guidance count as structured feedback. Do not require that exact phrase.
criteria.text: The treatment supplies structured task feedback and is compared with plain feedback.

criteria.clarifications: Include eligible conditions even if summary statistics needed for an effect are missing.
criteria.text: The study measures task scores or task completion.

mixed_condition_rule: Judge each condition separately; retain reasons for excluded conditions.
